ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake Fluid Canals
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Dig a channel, let a fluid flow into it: a species- and biome-agnostic engine for canals that carry water, ooze, slime, oil, tar or fuel from a source into the terrain a colonist chooses.
v1 slice (owner-ruled, 2026-09-01, "general RimMaster level" scope, promoted out of the tar-pits proposal's canal-flow-engineering row): dig a canal (`Designator_DigCanal`, a labor job on diggable soil), a `FluidDef` describing what a source carries, a `CompFluidReservoir` that seeds a flood once a canal reaches it, and `Flood_FluidCanal` (a `RimWorld.Flood` subclass — Odyssey's own flood-spread engine, reused rather than reinvented) that fills adjacent open ground with the fluid's terrain until the reservoir runs dry. Water is the one fluid shipped this pass, proving genericity; tar (the pass's own inspiration) is deliberately NOT included here — it is Utinni-tier content and belongs in its own client mod once this engine is live-proven.
Deliberately smaller than the full canal vision: no elevation-driven grade (maps carry none yet), no custom fire subclass (vanilla ignition already works on any flammable terrain, so a fluid with flammability > 0 needs nothing extra), no channel-only flow constraint (this pass floods outward across open passable ground from a canal-fed source, the same way vanilla's own SeasonalFlood does, not strictly along a dug channel — a v2 refinement). Requires Odyssey (Flood is Odyssey-gated in the base game).
